patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with dark (deep purple/black) and light (off-white/light grey) backgrounds to delineate content areas and provide visual rhythm.
Prominent, oversized sans-serif headings are used for primary messages, often paired with smaller, uppercase labels for section titles or sub-headings.
A high-contrast palette of deep darks and bright whites/off-whites is accented by a vibrant, luminous purple for calls to action and key interactive elements.
The hero section features a dynamic WebGL scene that transforms and reveals interactive UI elements (sliders, image previews) as the user scrolls, simulating an in-browser 'brand studio' experience.
Content sections are clearly defined by distinct background colors and often feature grid-based layouts for showcasing features, news, or trusted partners.

technique_notes: The hero utilizes a full-bleed WebGL experience (likely Three.js) to create an interactive, immersive environment that dynamically reveals product UI elements and content as the user scrolls, rather than a static image or simple video.
A transparent navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element, remaining fixed at the top of the viewport without significant visual transformation or shrinking on scroll.
Content sections below the hero primarily rely on static presentation, but internal components like carousels or image galleries may feature subtle animations or interactive transitions.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) provide strong visual hierarchy, complemented by clean, readable body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (approx. 4-8px) is applied consistently to buttons, input fields, and card corners, providing a soft, modern touch.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy density, with generous vertical padding between sections and comfortable spacing within grid layouts, creating an open and uncluttered feel.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the highly interactive and dynamic WebGL hero section that functions as a live 'brand studio' simulation. It immediately showcases the product's capabilities in an engaging, immersive way, moving beyond a typical static hero or video background.
